title: Crispy Midnight Tacos
description: A twist on traditional tacos, with crispy shells, midnight-colored vegetables, and a tangy Mexican twist. Serve with your favorite toppings.
instructions: Heat 1/4 cup of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Fry the corn tortillas until crispy and golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Drain the tortillas on paper towels.
In the same skillet, add the diced onions, bell peppers, and cumin. Cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Stir in the diced tomatoes and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Warm the tortillas by wrapping them in a damp paper towel and microwaving for 20-30 seconds.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the vegetable mixture onto a tortilla, followed by a sprinkle of cheese and a dollop of salsa.
Squeeze a sliver of lemon juice over the top of each taco.
